commands.when: resolve a period once and disclose UTC/local bounds
commands.recap: build a local temporal evidence pack
commands.context: build a local hierarchical evidence pack with optional segment drill-down
commands.find: run deterministic lexical matching inside a resolved period
commands.compare: compare two separately resolved periods by canonical event identity

errorContract: nonzero exit plus status=error and stable code
provenance: event IDs, digests, roles, UTC timestamps, and source refs remain attached
fallback: NotebookLM semantic search remains a separate candidate-finding path; it never replaces exact local period selection
